name: Mormotte
source:
Serizawa Koichi lost all previous memories after brain surgery. On awakening he learns that he agreed to participate in experiment for 31 day. During that time he's placed in a certain location together with other people. What kind of future will he choose?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
芹泽浩一在脑部手术后失去了所有记忆。醒来后，他得知自己同意参加为期31天的实验。在此期间，他将与其他人一起被安置在某个地点。他会选择怎样的未来？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
